description:
A connector that plugs Meteomatics' weather data directly. Ask natural language questions about real-time and forecast weather, and get instant structured data back, no manual API calls needed.

Used by: Energy traders, logistics companies, renewable operators, insurance teams, and aviation planners who need weather-intelligent AI workflows.
